proof.text: Use exists_finite_affine_flat_models to obtain finitely many ring diagrams on J = {i | i₀ ≤ i}, finitely presented maps φ_b, and the two equivalences detecting flatness at the limit and at each stage. This is exactly the geometric part of the original proof, collected separately without the algebraic descent assertion.

The upper tail J is nonempty (j₀ = i₀) and directed: take a common upper bound in I for two elements; it remains above i₀. For each b, use the limit flatness equivalence to get flatness of id tensor φ_b over colimit F_b. Apply RingHom.exists_eventually_flat_of_colimit_flat to F_b, j₀ and φ_b. This gives k_b ≥ j₀ and flatness of the tensor map at every j ≥ k_b.

Choose the k_b in the proof. By finite-set induction, using directedness at each insertion and j₀ for the empty set, find a common upper bound j for all k_b. Apply the eventual assertion for each b at j, and the stage flatness equivalence, to obtain flatness of the pulled-back f₀ at j.val ≥ i₀. All glue in this step is implemented in Lean, including the empty family.

title: Flatness descends to a finite stage of a limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set, with a chosen element $0$, and let $(S_i,t_{ii'})$ be an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine transition morphisms $t_{ii'}:S_i\to S_{i'}$ for $i\ge i'$ [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism over $S_0$, with $S_0,X_0,Y_0$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $i\ge0$ put $X_i=X_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, $Y_i=Y_0\times_{S_0}S_i$ and $f_i=f_0\times\mathrm{id}_{S_i}$, and put $X=X_0\times_{S_0}S$, $Y=Y_0\times_{S_0}S$, $f=f_0\times\mathrm{id}_S$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and $f_0$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], then $f_i$ is flat for some $i\ge0$.

split_report.summary: Not a Mathlib leaf (three kinds of search, also by the creator; Mathlib has no descent of flatness to a stage of a limit; AffineTransitionLimit.lean has no flatness). Statement checked against Limits 04AI in Situation 081D (tags 04AI, 081D, 02JO verified in tags/tags): unchanged. Proof in 6 steps following 04AI: finitely many affine triples W_b, V_b, U_b (only quasi-compactness of X_0 used; lfp gives phi_0 of finite presentation, 01TQ leaf), the base over W_b as Spec of the directed colimit of the A_i (01YW node and Spec-colimit leaf), the pieces of f_T as Spec(id (x) phi_0), flatness of the piece over S read stalkwise (local rings of open subschemes, Spec-flat iff ring-flat leaf 01U5), the algebra result through a new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-colimit-flat-ring-map (the algebra statement of the 04AI proof, from Algebra 02JO (3), concluding for all sufficiently large i so no separate persistence step is needed), and a common index with the stalkwise definition of flat. The affine reduction mirrors the reviewed split of lem-weil-pbc-descend-etale (07RP). Source typo: the 04AI proof writes 'an R_0-algebra map A_i -> B_i' for A_0 -> B_0. Existing 00R6 node lem-weil-pbc-colimit-eventually-flat is what the new node's own split (02JO (3) via 00QX/00R6 and openness of flatness) will use; not cited here.
